name: LocalAI
tagline: Self-hosted drop-in OpenAI API replacement for running local LLMs, embeddings, audio, and images offline.
real_test_summary: Tested running a single local server exposing chat completions, embeddings, and speech endpoints offline. Simplifies pointing existing OpenAI SDK apps to local models.
pros: Single local server supporting chat, embeddings, TTS, and STT endpoints
Compatible with existing OpenAI SDKs without code rewrites
MIT open-source license with container and binary distributions
cons: Configuring multiple model backends can require trial and error
Dedicated single-purpose runners may edge it out on raw speed
